cat > full.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
from scipy.optimize import differential_evolution
lines=open('fragopt.xyz').read().splitlines()[2:]
sym=[l.split()[0] for l in lines]; p=np.array([[float(y) for y in l.split()[1:]] for l in lines]);v=p-p[26];n=np.linalg.norm(v,axis=1)
def calc(u):
 d=np.linalg.norm(v-2.53*u,axis=1);d[26]=999
 # avoid any atom too close Au (hydrogens can approach closer than N/O)
 dnorm=d.copy(); dnorm[np.array(sym)=='H']+=0.25
 return dnorm.min()
rng=np.random.default_rng(941);s=rng.normal(size=(100000,3));s/=np.linalg.norm(s,axis=1)[:,None]
bests=sorted([(calc(u),u) for u in s],key=lambda x:-x[0])[:5]
for val,u in bests: print('closest',val,'unit',u,'coord dots',[(i,round(float(u@v[i]/n[i]),2)) for i in [0,12,13,25]])
ux=bests[0][1]; uy=v[0]+v[12];uy-=ux*np.dot(uy,ux);uy/=np.linalg.norm(uy);uz=np.cross(ux,uy)
coords=v@np.stack([ux,uy,uz],axis=1)
left=coords+np.array([-2.53,0,0]);right=(coords*np.array([-1,1,-1]))+np.array([2.53,0,0]);
# choose angular disposition between Ge ligand arrangements on right, rotate along x by some angle if necessary
rightarr=[]
for phi in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,61):
 pp=right.copy(); c=np.cos(phi);ss=np.sin(phi);pp[:,1:]=right[:,1:]@np.array([[c,ss],[-ss,c]])
 dist=cdist(left,pp)
 score=np.min(dist)
 rightarr.append((score,phi,pp))
score,phi,right=max(rightarr,key=lambda x:x[0]);print('best angle of right',np.rad2deg(phi), 'min fragment interatomic distance',score)
with open('initial_full.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write('75\nCation bis(germylene)gold complex, 4 trifluoromethyl pyridyl enolates\n')
 for j in range(2):
  for i,(s,xyz) in enumerate(zip(sym,left if j==0 else right)):
   f.write('%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f\n'%(s,*xyz))
 f.write('%-2s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f\n'%('Au',0.,0.,0.))
PY
